newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - July 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - July 10.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Qatar has taken delivery of the last of four fast strike vessels from British shipbuilder Vosper Thornycroft.
- Japanese marine paints manufacturer Chugoku has set up an operations base in Dubai ahead of a wider push to raise exposure levels in the Middle East.
- Chrysler's Middle East sales rose 14 percent in June, compared with the same month last year.
- The UAE's MashreqBank is opening a branch in New Delhi in September as part of international expansion plans.

- Express mail has emerged as one of the fastest growing sectors in the UAE and other Arab countries due to an economic upswing in the region, a study by the Dubai Chamber of Commerce and Industry said.

- Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank's share offer has been heavily oversubscribed, with subscription around six billion dirhams seen, banking sources said. The bank was set up with a capital of one billion dirhams.
